build_transformer_mlp_block: build a transformer MLP feed-forward block with configurable hidden dimension and dropout
create_patch_merger_3d: create a 3D patch merger that merges adjacent patches using SwinTransformer-style subsampling
build_detr_attention: build a DETR multi-head dot-product attention module with positional embeddings and key padding masks
create_detr_decoder_block: create a DETR transformer decoder block with self-attention, cross-attention, and MLP layers
run_dot_product_attention: run dot-product attention with query, key, value tensors and optional attention bias masking
